exposure: craniosynostosis surgery in a low-volume center
cohort: The study included 42 patients (median age 7.4 months) who underwent craniofacial surgery for various forms of craniosynostosis between 2012 and 2017.
finding: The study found that complication rates are a more significant indicator of the quality of craniosynostosis care than the number of procedures, mean hospital stay, or blood transfusion rates.
